SessionStart.bash: printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Read AGENTS.md and use /orchestrate init if .agent-sync/TEAM.md is missing. The project installer is required for hook scripts."}'
SessionStart.powershell: Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Read AGENTS.md and use /orchestrate init if .agent-sync/TEAM.md is missing. The project installer is required for hook scripts."}'

PreToolUse.bash: if test -f scripts/pre_tool_use.py; then python3 scripts/pre_tool_use.py; else printf '%s\n' '[A Team] WARNING: project guard absent; run install.sh' >&2; fi
PreToolUse.powershell: if (Test-Path scripts/pre_tool_use.py) { python scripts/pre_tool_use.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('[A Team] WARNING: project guard absent; run install.ps1') }

PostToolUse.bash: printf '%s\n' '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Verify modified code and request a code review before committing."}'
PostToolUse.powershell: Write-Output '{"additionalContext":"[A Team] Verify modified code and request a code review before committing."}'

SessionEnd.bash: if test -f scripts/metrics.py; then python3 scripts/metrics.py session_end; fi
